statements.statement: The patient has a history of atherosclerotic heart disease
The patient reports intermittent episodes of palpitations accompanied by dizziness and giddiness
A cardiac event monitoring study (CPT 93271) was ordered
The service was ordered for ambulatory assessment
The service was ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes correlating with these symptoms
The diagnosis codes are I25.10, R00.2, and R42
The denial is based on the service not being covered under the member's current benefit plan
